decoys.why: No modifier, but the body reverts NotPendingSteward unless msg.sender equals pendingSteward, which only the steward can set; the address(0) default can never match a caller.
A view that returns configuration and per-asset accruals already readable through the public getters and outstandingProceeds; it writes no storage and gives the caller no control over funds.

acceptable.note: low, unscored: releaseProceeds pushes both shares in one call, so a recipient that cannot receive the asset blocks the other share until the steward repoints it
info, unscored: a nomination cannot be cleared to address(0), only overwritten with another nominee
